Settings_ActivateThisProfileOpensIts: Activate this profile (opens its Home workspace)
Settings_ActivateThisWorkspaceAndEdit: Activate this workspace and edit its pages
Settings_AlsoApplyThisRuleWhen: Also apply this rule when the process starts, not only on focus
Settings_AppliesImmediatelySomeControlsK: Applies immediately. Some controls keep the previous palette until next app launch.
Settings_BrieflyDisplaysTheNewPage: Briefly displays the new page name on the first touch button (~2s) after switching touch or rotary pages.
Settings_ChooseQuitOnDesktopsWithout: Choose 'Quit' on desktops without a system tray.
Settings_DrawsACrosshairTileOn: Draws a crosshair tile on every key. Ends when this window closes or you press a key on the device.
Settings_ExportThisPageAsA: Export this page as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_ExportThisProfileAsA: Export this profile as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_ExportThisWorkspaceAsA: Export this workspace as a .loupixprofile package
Settings_FfmpegWasNotFoundOn: ffmpeg was not found on PATH. Install ffmpeg to use a video screensaver.
Settings_FillsTheWholeDisplayAfter: Fills the whole display after the device is idle — either a video/GIF or a plugin-provided animation. Stops on any input.
Settings_IgnoresAdditionalTOUCHSTARTEven: Ignores additional TOUCH_START events until the finger is lifted. Defends against duplicate triggers when sliding across buttons or tapping near a button boundary.
Settings_KeepTheCurrentProfileThe: Keep the current profile: the profile the last rule activated stays active until another rule matches. Return to the profile active before the rule: undo the switch a rule made. Switch to a fixed fallback profile: always activate the profile chosen above.
Settings_MakeThisTheProfileS: Make this the profile's Home workspace
Settings_OpenSourceAvaloniaDesktopApp: Open-source Avalonia desktop app controlling the Loupedeck Live S on Linux and Windows.
Settings_PreventMultiTriggerWhileFinger: Prevent multi-trigger while finger is down
Settings_ProfilesGroupWorkspacesForAn: Profiles group workspaces for an app or scenario. Each profile opens on its Home workspace. Activating a workspace switches what the device shows and edits its pages under Pages.
Settings_ProvidedByInstalledPluginsNo: Provided by installed plugins. No ffmpeg needed.
Settings_ShowPageNameOverlayWhen: Show page name overlay when switching pages
Settings_SlideTheSideDisplaysWhen: Slide the side displays when a rotary page is changed by a command or button. Swipe gestures always animate. Turn off for instant command paging.
Settings_SlideTheTouchDisplayWhen: Slide the touch display when a touch page changes. Turn off for instant paging.
Settings_SmoothsColourGradientsByMixing: Smooths colour gradients by mixing adjacent shades. Most noticeable on the Razer Stream Controller, whose panel shows only 16 levels of red.
Settings_SomeChangesFinishApplyingAfter: Some changes finish applying after the app is restarted.
Settings_SwitchProfilesAndWorkspacesBase: Switch profiles and workspaces based on the active application
Settings_TheHighestPriorityMatchingRule: The highest-priority matching rule activates its profile and workspace. Process names match case-insensitively; a trailing ".exe" is ignored. On Linux this needs an X11 / XWayland session and 'xprop'.
Settings_TheHighestPriorityMatchingRule2: The highest-priority matching rule wins; ties are broken by list order. Leave 'Profile' empty to keep the current profile, and 'Workspace' empty to open the profile's Home workspace. A manual profile/workspace switch pauses automatic switching until you change apps.
Settings_TheInterceptionDriverIsThird: The Interception driver is third-party software by Francisco Lopes (github.com/oblitum/Interception). It is free for non-commercial use only — commercial use requires a separate license from its author.
Settings_TheInterceptionKernelDriverLets: The Interception kernel driver lets keyboard and mouse macros reach apps that read raw input (games / anti-cheat), which the default SendInput method cannot. The driver is downloaded from the official GitHub release and is not bundled. Installing or removing it requires a reboot.
Settings_TheLanguageAppliesImmediatelyAn: The language applies immediately and is shared by all devices.
Settings_UseInterceptionForKeyboardAnd: Use Interception for keyboard and mouse macros
Settings_UsedWhenThePluginDeclares: used when the plugin declares no frame rate of its own
Settings_WhenOffOrWhenThe: When off (or when the driver is not installed), macros fall back to SendInput. Takes effect immediately.
Settings_WhereTheAppPlacesThe: Where the app places the key tiles on the panel. Turn on the test pattern and adjust until each tile's crosshair sits in the middle of its key and its border runs along the key's edge. Only needed if the picture is offset or the wrong size on the device.
TouchButton_BackgroundColorOfTheSelected: Background color of the selected state — each state has its own, drawn below every layer
TouchButton_CentersTheTextInsideIts: Centers the text inside its box and positions relative to the button center
TouchButton_ClearsLayersColorsAndThe: Clears layers, colors and the command of this button
TouchButton_ContentIsOwnedByThe: Content is owned by the plugin. Move, scale, rotate or hide it here; remove it by unbinding the button's command.
TouchButton_ContentRenderedByAPlugin: Content rendered by a plugin command
TouchButton_DrawsTheSelectedStateS: Draws the selected state's background color, covering the page wallpaper. Off leaves the key bare — the wallpaper shows through, or black when the page has none.
TouchButton_EmptyClickThisStripThen: Empty — click this strip, then double-click a command in the Commands tab, or drag one here.
TouchButton_FitTheCanvasToThe: Fit the canvas to the view
TouchButton_HoldAltDragAHandle: Hold Alt + drag a handle to crop. Hold Shift to unlock aspect ratio while scaling.
TouchButton_LayoutAreaForTheText: Layout area for the text — drag handles in the preview to change.
TouchButton_PickAnInstalledApplicationSe: Pick an installed application: sets this button's launch command and its icon
TouchButton_RemoveAllCommandsInThis: Remove all commands in this sequence
TouchButton_RemoveLayerPluginOwnedLayers: Remove layer (plugin-owned layers are removed by unbinding the command)
TouchButton_ResetToDefaultOnPage: Reset to default on page change
TouchButton_SnapLayersToTheGrid: Snap layers to the grid while dragging
TouchButton_StatesAreManagedByThe: States are managed by the assigned command.
TouchButton_SwitchToFreeDrawToEdit: Switch to FreeDraw to edit the strip canvas. In Segmented mode the strip shows the three dial labels.
TouchButton_TheSelectedPluginRendersThis: The selected plugin renders this strip and handles its taps and swipes.
TouchButton_ThisStripHasThreeTap: This strip has three tap zones (top/middle/bottom), each with its own command sequence below. Enable Grid to see the segment boundaries.
TouchButton_ThisStripIsnTIn: This strip isn't in FreeDraw mode. Switch Mode to FreeDraw to draw on it.
